method: Fresh isolated campaign; normal browser commands only. Read-only API checkpoints. Build and save remain unchanged during the campaign. Reading and reporting time included in wall duration.
observations: Opening two courier jobs and cautious authored arrangement: reload preserved $240, respect7, heat0 at11:00. Manual voice reached Speaking state promptly; decisions remained available. Audio quality was not assessed by listening.

Queued local-AI mediation appeared on completed arrival at Bluebird11:25; dialogue named The Monarch and Bellandi, stakes matched $55/60min/+5respect/+6Bellandi. A practical contract dispute, no explicit unsupported ownership/deadline promise. Completed12:25 at$295.

Acquired Bluebird for$180/60min at13:25, cash115 respect16. People panel labels even faction bosses as Independent contact; guide still calls The Monarch a casino rather than a club. Cosmetic city placeholders remain for visual owner.

Recruited Leo14:20, then completed cautious local-AI collection16:20: $37 + $115 reward + $28 passive income = $180, heat2. Follow-up card correctly shows prior mediation, but prose has no explicit callback and adds a vague debt promise and weeks-ago backstory.

Coffee interrupted by first demand16:25: no coffee fee/contact awarded. Refused tribute, then bought two coffees. Expanded Ashbury for$100/90min. Sabotage reduced laundry to85%; ledger explicitly credited Leo with preventing20 additional condition loss.

Leo brought the next AI courier, confirming cast change. Task named Monarch pickup and docks recipient; beneficiary Bellandi supplied by stakes but not named in dialogue. Crew speaks as employer (I will pay you), still awkward hierarchy. Press approach yielded$95/30min/+8heat as displayed.
Rented Ashbury19:55 to20:55, delegated Leo21:10, rested untilDay2 01:10. Cash103, health100, heat5, apartment and Leo retained after midnight bills. No home security yet; laundry85%.
Correction to terminology finding: address book also classifies The Monarch as casino. It is mixed casino/club terminology across game prose, not simply a wrong guide category.

Natural integration path: collection startedDay2 03:00, demand interrupted04:25 with5minremaining. Paid$60, reloaded, resumed5min into police check at04:30. Paid$40 and received$130 once; cash147 respect37 heat5. Ledger incorrectly titles job completion Too familiar a face (police scene title); canonical prior-job card later still shows An overdue payment.

Bought Bellandi business ceasefire for$100 at05:15; Families showed expiryDay3 05:15 and personal-threat exclusion. ProvokedMonarch05:45, returnedhome, completedanothercourier. Rest interrupted by known warning07:45 despite business agreement.

Added second security detail08:15. Explicitly requested another AI encounter through Settings during known danger; read-only public state confirmed ready before rest. Rest stopped09:15 at attack, no routine dialogue displaced it. Held entrance and died with no reroll. Death survives reload. Cash64, respect41, earned991, laundry85% passed to survivors.

Families screenshot readable at1235x1051, but it omits the known personal threat and says relationship waiting to take shape even while the City screen names an active hit. This misleading functional feedback needs correction. Browser reported no warnings/errors.
Later Mara courier invents new business arrangement with a rival outfit; no corresponding inter-family agreement exists in the exposed gameplay. Coherence acceptance still fails.

New life Nico startsDay2 17:15 with$90, respect0, health100, heat0, no crew/security/businesses. Families reset personal standings and omit previous ceasefire; Alex death remains in history. Read-only save verification after play confirms old queued offers, suspended job and business truce cleared. First life lasted11m08s wall time, not another20-minute campaign.
